ink.name: Ink -- ink-stroke drawing content and the pencil/eraser tool defaults it is drawn with (edit-block-ink-stroke, change-pencil-width, change-block-ink-width, change-eraser-radius)

text.name: Text -- a text block's rich-text paragraph content (edit-block-text)

math.name: Math -- a math block's TeX source (edit-block-math)

table.name: Table -- a table block's row/column structure (insert-table-row, remove-table-row, insert-table-column, remove-table-column)

asset.name: Asset -- the id-keyed image asset pool, independent of any block (create-asset, replace-asset-payload, delete-asset)

block.name: Block -- kind-agnostic block lifecycle and placement over the id-keyed, z-order-meaningful, group-nestable block tree (create-block, delete-block, delete-blocks, duplicate-block, duplicate-blocks, move-block-to-container, drag-blocks, rename-block, change-block-visible, change-block-locked, move-block, resize-block, change-block-font-size)

canvas.name: Canvas -- canvas-wide grid and snap tool settings, not block content (change-grid-visible, change-grid-spacing, change-grid-subdivisions, change-grid-opacity, change-snap-enabled, change-snap-grid-spacing)

document.name: Document -- the document's own identity field (rename-note)
